name: comp-584
title: Simple Nav Header
blurb: Navbar with search bar and bottom nav menu strip.
description: Header with logo, search input, notifications, and user menu. Below-header strip with text nav links. Responsive: mobile hides nav strip.
use_when: Apps with central search as a key feature, plus secondary navigation underneath the header.
avoid_when: Limited vertical space; this layout takes two rows at minimum on desktop.
a11y: Search input labeled. Nav links keyboard-navigable. Mobile search icon visible; desktop shows full search input.
